convert_checkpoint_to_hf_format: convert an EfficientSAM3 LiteText checkpoint to HuggingFace format and save to a directory
infer_text_config_from_checkpoint: infer Sam3LiteTextTextConfig hyperparameters automatically from a raw checkpoint state dict
split_qkv_projections: split combined QKV projections into separate Q, K, V projections in a state dict
convert_key_mapping: convert original SAM3 LiteText checkpoint keys to HuggingFace format using regex patterns
run_conversion_cli: run the CLI tool to download, convert, and optionally push a SAM3 LiteText model to the Hugging Face Hub
